name: Bernd Lange - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision concerning the withdrawal of the European Union from the International Rubber Study Group (IRSG)
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that the European Union should leave the International Rubber Study Group. This group is an international body that brings together countries and industry to share information about rubber. The Parliament's approval is one required step before the exit can happen. The report itself does not change any rules; it gives the Parliament's consent to a decision already proposed by the Council of the European Union.

- The European Union would withdraw from the International Rubber Study Group.
- This affects the European Union, its member states and the group's other members.
- The Council can now finalise the withdrawal decision.
